 ‘Mama Bear’ – Watch Curry Barker’s Brand New Horror Short
 John Squires 
 October 29, 2026

 Copy link 
 While we wait for his next feature Anything But Ghosts , Curry Barker is back this Halloween with Mama Bear , a new horror short the Obsession filmmaker made in collaboration with Windows.
 Mama Bear is written, directed and edited by Curry Barker, and th e cast includes Jon Lee Richardson as Floyd, Katie Sarife as Lacey, Ericka Kreuz as Ms. Wilson, and Joshua Snyder as Floyd’s Doppelgänger. The short  reunites Barker with Obsession production designer Vivian Gray.   
 Mama Bear feels like it’s plucked right out of the Obsession universe, with somebody somewhere cracking open a One Wish Willow some time before the events of the short. It’s not a horror short about obsession, however, but rather one that plunges a man into a nightmare that begins with a chilling phone call and ends with the reveal that he’s not the only version of himself.
 He’s got a Doppelgänger, and that Doppelgänger has just done something terrible… 
 Obsession may have made Curry Barker a highly in-demand filmmaker, but it was his viral YouTube horror shorts like The Chair that paved the way for his breakout hit. Milk & Serial was Barker’s second horror project, released on the comedy channel  That’s a Bad Idea . 
 Mama Bear returns Barker to his short film roots this Halloween. Watch it below.
